title: Wizard and Apprentices Ritual
description: A hooded wizard in a green robe and dripping red hat stands behind a stone table in a candlelit dungeon, overseeing two robed apprentices who are drawing magic circles with quills. The table holds a pile of dark material with red liquid, ritual rings, papers with occult symbols, and a lit candle, while the stone walls display framed drawings of insects, constellations, and geometric patterns.
prompt: A mysterious hooded wizard wearing a tall dripping red hat and ornate green robe stands in a stone dungeon chamber, overseeing two hooded apprentices seated at a wooden table. The apprentices are drawing intricate magic circles and symbols with quills on parchment. On the table is a large pile of black material dripping with red liquid, golden rings, scattered papers with occult diagrams, a lit candle, and a smoking censer. The rough stone walls are covered with framed drawings of beetles, constellations, and geometric patterns. Warm candlelight illuminates the scene with floating bokeh orbs and mystical atmosphere.
